title: The Twelve Zodia and the Cosmic Body
description: T70 explains how the twelve zodia bound in the sphere are forms of the proprium drawn from the natural mind in its five aspects under self-love (two states per aspect), enemies to one another, plundering one another, held together only by the Lord's operative power that permits the structure. The five wandering self-loves were begotten in the same way; the sun and moon are not of them but the redemptive economy by which captive light is taken up. T71 expounds the natural mind shaped as a body: head as inmost firstfruit of accommodation, neck through ten ordered degrees, heart as cycle of regeneration, thighs as moving register of perception, legs and feet as threefold ground; with the rational keeping its post in five watches over the discrete degrees. The whole small body of the person exists in the likeness of the structured field of the natural mind.
